checked_classes: Spec violations — the scoped diff only updates the stale affected-query integration expectation, matching the acceptance note that production behavior already emits `NO EXACT MATCH` for absent targets.
Correctness — the assertion still exercises the same absent-target path and preserves a diagnostic containment check; no logic path is removed beyond the obsolete expected substring.
Regressions — no production code or public behavior is changed, and the test continues to assert that absent affected-query resolution emits an error diagnostic.
Security — the diff modifies only a test assertion string and introduces no new input handling, network, credential, path, subprocess, or serialization boundary.
Constraint breaches — the diff introduces no unsafe code, unwrap/expect/panic usage, dependencies, generated artifacts, product-boundary references, or nondeterministic data structures.
Silent failure — the assertion remains an active `assert!` on the result of `format_affected`, so the absent-target diagnostic is not swallowed or skipped.
